text:
Nora (Marketing): Quick sync 1 — planning the v2 announcement for next Tue 9am PT. Need final public changelog URL, prod docs link, a 2-sentence benchmark blurb, confirmation of canary % and rollback criteria, and the webinar signup + demo routing. Can we lock by Mon noon?
Diego (Eng): Mon noon freeze ok. We'll do a 7% canary and auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.4% for 5m. Draft changelog living in PR #2466 (internal) 1 will make public when merged.
Priya (Docs): I'll stage the docs page and FAQ item. Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/v2/serve. If you drop the final API snippet here I'll merge by Mon 10:30am PT.
Zoe (Bench): Uploaded summary + CSVs: https://drive.google.com/benches/v2. TL;DR: p50 ~2.0x improvement on short prompts; p95 depends on batching but up to 1.8x better in conservative configs. I'll write a 2-line narrative for the blog.
Nora (Marketing): For messaging keep it "up to Xx faster" language and include a single line about tradeoffs for long sequences/quantized models. Also want a 20-30s webinar teaser we can embed.
Diego (Eng): API snippet added in PR #2466. Canary config we'll push as: ```json
{"rollout": {"canary_fraction": 0.07, "fallback": "v1", "rollback_threshold": 0.004}}
```
ReleaseBot: Canary scheduled 2026-07-07T16:00:00Z (initiated by @Diego)
Omar (Sales): For inbound routing: add hidden field lead_tier=enterprise and post to our webhook https://hooks.redwood.ai/sales/demo. I will own follow-ups and set auto-assign.
Priya (Docs): Staging -> https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/v2/serve now; will flip to prod after PR merge and add a changelog anchor. Adding quantization caveat & recommended batch sizes to FAQ.
Diego (Eng): PR merged; public changelog: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v2. Canary running, dashboards green so far.
Zoe (Bench): Re-ran long-seq tests; small accuracy variance with quantized weights noted in the notes. Final narrative attached to the sheet: "Bench summary: In typical short-chat and single-turn inference, v2 delivers up to 2x faster p50; for very long sequences throughput gains reduce and quantized variants may show slight accuracy shifts."
Nora (Marketing): Draft announcement copy posted: https://docs.google.com/announce-v2. Please leave comments by Mon 4pm PT. Embargo: Tue 8:45am PT. I'll own press assets and the webinar page.
Omar (Sales): Webinar signup page live, CTA text = "Request a dedicated demo" -> https://redwood.ai/demo. Hidden field & webhook tested, demo queue confirmed.
Diego (Eng): Ops note: rollback flag in prod ready if canary error spikes.
ReleaseBot: Deployment completed 2026-07-07T16:09:30Z (canary 7%)
Nora (Marketing): Final checklist: changelog live? docs prod? bench blurb done? canary set? webinar + demo routing live? press owner?
Diego (Eng): Changelog live: yes. Docs prod: yes. Canary set: yes.
Zoe (Bench): Bench blurb done and linked in the announce doc.
Omar (Sales): Webinar + demo routing live and webhook receiving test leads.
Nora (Marketing): Great, scheduling publish for Tue 9am PT and sending embargo notes to press list. Thanks everyone :party_popper:
